about.desc: Yobi builds automation on top of AI web services by driving their web interfaces in a built-in browser window. By default it does not use the providers' official APIs and does not run a local model; an optional BYOK mode can call any OpenAI-compatible endpoint or the Gemini API with your own key. Trigger it with global hotkeys, flows, schedules, or Telegram, across ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Duck.ai.

Balanced mix samples newest + lowest + highest so good and bad reviews are both represented. On failure the error is logged and the output becomes an empty list.

flow.skill.js.hint: Previous step outputs are available as variables by their output key (e.g. {{outputKey}} is the variable outputKey). Use `return` to set this block's output — objects are JSON-stringified. Built-ins available: JSON, Math, Date, fetch, URL, URLSearchParams, Buffer, TextEncoder, TextDecoder, crypto, structuredClone. Runs in-process at the same trust level as the Shell block.

line.help.usageCommands:
How to use me:

• A command plus your text — pick an AI model, hand a multi-step task to the agent, or search the web. The full list is below.
• If the agent needs to know more it asks, and your next plain reply carries on from there.
• A link after the command — I read the page first, then hand it to the AI.
• A YouTube link — I fetch the transcript first.

Commands: {{commands}}

Command-free chat is off, so plain text without a command isn’t sent to the AI (turn it on in Yobi → Settings).
Answers take a while: the AI runs on my owner’s computer, and I message you as soon as it finishes.
Send /help to see this again.
line.help.usageDirect:
How to use me:

• Send any text — I hand it to the AI and send the answer back.
• Send a link — I read the page first, then hand it to the AI.
• Send a YouTube link — I fetch the transcript first.
• A command plus your text — pick an AI model, hand a multi-step task to the agent, or search the web. The full list is below.
• If the agent needs to know more it asks, and your next plain reply carries on from there.
• In a group, tag me with your question: @Bot …

Commands: {{commands}}

Answers take a while: the AI runs on my owner’s computer, and I message you as soon as it finishes.
Send /help to see this again.

youtube.prompt.default:
# Task: YouTube Video Summary & Analysis

You are my video summarization assistant. Analyze the YouTube video below using its transcript.

## 📥 Source

- **[Title]**: {{title}}

- **[URL]**: {{url}}

- **[Transcript]**:

---
{{transcript}}
---

## 🎯 Output Requirements (Respond in English)

Skip pleasantries. Output directly in Markdown:

### 1. ⚡ TL;DR

The core message of the video in one or two sentences.

### 2. 📝 Key Points

The main topics, arguments, and takeaways in a logical order (use bullets or a timeline if helpful).

### 3. 💡 Conclusions & Takeaways

The video's conclusion plus any actionable insights for the viewer.

---
⚠️ **Note**: If no transcript is provided, watch the video at the URL above and summarize it directly.
